summary_md: **老林在路上 ([@laolinwalks](https://x.com/laolinwalks/status/2116405305253019715))** explains *DiscoveryRSI* ([arXiv 2610.23839](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23839), [code](https://github.com/Gen-Verse/DiscoveryRSI), [arena](https://foundry-arena.rsi-arena.workers.dev/arena)). Lead, generate, evolve, critique and progress agents grow hypothesis trees and compile them into Harbor tasks. The system improves itself through TrueSkill credit for hypotheses (DiscoveryRSI-27B), harness replay of failures and rediscovery on new problems in DFM-Bench life-science domains.
